name: wrong-status
bug_class: wrong HTTP status for a missing resource
real_breakage: GET /api/articles/999 returns HTTP 200 with {"error":"article not found"} instead of HTTP 404 — the server always writes 200 and the README/check declare 404 as the contract
green_tests: tests/render.test.mjs asserts the JSON payloads only (including the error payload for a missing article); the HTTP status is never checked
